public_gates: export candidates and compact corpus for M452 near and late runs
summary separates dependency classes and failure classes
forbidden_shortcuts: do not change actor input/output contract
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not use corpus labels as actor inputs
hypothesis: A structured response-critical exporter can turn M452 ablation rows into an interpretable corpus that separates current-response dependence from recurrent-history and action-history dependence.
success_criteria: exporter writes candidates CSV compact CSV and summary JSON
documentation classifies the resulting corpus as strong moderate or weak evidence
failure_criteria: dependency and failure modes remain conflated
corpus labels are treated as deployable actor inputs

commands.name: export_response_critical_corpus
commands.command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.response_critical_ablation_corpus --episodes-csv runs/m452_near_robust_ablation_seed9900/episodes.csv --source-config near_robust --episodes-csv runs/m452_late_robust_ablation_seed9900/episodes.csv --source-config late_robust --baseline-policy m399_base --candidate-policy m399_reset --candidate-policy m399_zero_current --candidate-policy m399_zero_all --candidate-policy m399_noact --run-dir runs/m454_response_critical_ablation_corpus

decision_rule: M454 passes if it exports and documents the response-critical corpus honestly. It cannot promote a checkpoint.
